Construction Services in Mulvane, KS

Mulvane is a south Sedgwick County community of roughly 6,500 residents along the Arkansas River corridor south of Derby and Wichita. The area sits near the Sedgwick-Sumner County line and draws homeowners who want the southern edge of the metro — smaller community, rural feel, and reasonable access to the Wichita job market.

The housing stock is mixed — older original-townsite properties near downtown Mulvane, mid-century ranches along the established corridors, and newer development on the south edge and along the rural routes toward the Sumner County line. Wheatland Construction serves Mulvane and the southern Sedgwick County corridor. We permit through the City of Mulvane for in-town work and through Sedgwick County for rural properties.

What We Build in Mulvane

Custom Homes

Mulvane-area rural lots — particularly along county roads south and east of town toward Sumner County — attract homeowners building custom homes with more acreage. We build custom homes in the Mulvane area from foundation through finish, with appropriate Sedgwick County or City of Mulvane permits. See Custom Home Building in Mulvane →

Home Additions

Mulvane's mid-century housing stock has modest square footage that families frequently outgrow. Room additions, master suite expansions, and garage buildouts are common. We match existing exterior materials and rooflines so additions integrate naturally. See Home Additions in Mulvane →

Basement Finishing

Mulvane sits in the Arkansas River valley — the soil profile here includes alluvial deposits and seasonal drainage considerations that affect moisture behavior in basements. We assess every Mulvane basement for moisture and drainage before recommending a finishing scope. When the conditions are right, Mulvane basements add meaningful living space. See Basement Finishing in Mulvane →

Bathroom Remodeling

Mulvane's older homes have mid-century bathrooms at or past end of useful life — original plumbing, dated tile, and finishes from 50+ years ago. Newer properties have 1990s builder-grade bathrooms approaching the same threshold. We remodel them completely: new tile, new vanity, updated plumbing where needed. See Bathroom Remodeling in Mulvane →

Kitchen Remodeling

Mulvane kitchens in the original-townsite homes frequently have narrow galley layouts and materials from the mid-20th century. Newer homes have 1990s kitchens that need updating. We handle both — from targeted refreshes to full gut-and-replace. See Kitchen Remodeling in Mulvane →

Major Remodels

Older Mulvane properties sometimes need broader renovation — comprehensive projects where multiple systems and finishes get addressed at once. We manage major remodel scopes with coordinated trades and full permit coverage. See Major Remodels in Mulvane →

Roofing

South Sedgwick County's storm exposure is significant — the Arkansas River valley corridor channels south-to-north wind that makes Mulvane's roofing exposure meaningful. We install roofing systems appropriate for south Kansas conditions and handle insurance documentation when applicable. See Roofing in Mulvane →

Mulvane Permit Jurisdiction

In-town Mulvane properties permit through the City of Mulvane. Rural properties on county routes permit through Sedgwick County. We handle all applications and inspections.

Why Mulvane Homeowners Choose Wheatland

We serve the south Sedgwick County corridor and we understand the rural and small-town residential market here. Written estimates, own crews, no hidden charges.
